parsed.observations: Green leaves and sheath-like tissue show numerous reddish-brown raised pustules, including large elongated lesions with pale, ragged-looking margins. Some leaf pustules are oval and scattered. No white powdery growth or black-dotted necrotic blotches are visible.
parsed.summary: The visible large, elongated reddish-brown pustules with ragged margins on leaves and sheath-like tissue are most consistent with stem rust.
